notes_i18n.en: My Menu: show icon only (an empty name no longer shows "?"), pick a custom icon (.ico, .png, .exe…) and add separators. / Website now in all 26 app languages; the user guide has 7 new topics (Home, pane as preview, folder preview, columns, My Menu, file colors, Lightweight mode).
